title: MECHANICAL SUPERVISOR
industry: Mechanical, Mining, Oil and Gas, Operations Support
description:
MECHANICAL SUPERVISOR
Quest Exploration Drilling (QED) is PNG’s leading drilling service provider, with a proud history of safe and reliable operations across the country. We take pride in maintaining high standards of safety, teamwork, and performance on every project we undertake.
We’re looking for experienced and motivated
Mechanical Supervisors
to join our dynamic team. This role is ideal for someone who takes ownership of their work, values safety, and enjoys leading and developing young up-and-coming nationals in a hands-on environment.
What you’ll do:
Lead and mentor a team of mechanical technicians, providing training, guidance, and performance feedback.
Plan and coordinate daily mechanical activities to ensure work is completed safely, efficiently, and to quality standards.
Oversee maintenance and repairs for drilling and support equipment, including both preventive and corrective work.
Provide technical support for hydraulic, pneumatic, and electrical systems, ensuring equipment operates at peak performance.
Champion safety by ensuring all work follows company policies and industry standards.
Troubleshoot and resolve mechanical issues quickly to keep operations running smoothly.
Maintain accurate records of maintenance, inspections, and project progress.
What we’re looking for:
Solid experience in mechanical supervision, ideally within the drilling or heavy equipment industry.
Strong working knowledge of drill rigs, OEM experience with
Epiroc, Sandvik, or CAT
equipment is preferred.
Proven ability to lead, motivate, and support a team in the field.
Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
Well-organized, safety-focused, and able to manage competing priorities.
Physically fit and comfortable working in various field environments.
Additional requirements:
Applicants must be able to pass a
Pre-Employment Medical Examination
and provide a current
Police Clearance Certificate.
If you’re ready to take the next step in your career and be part of a respected team in PNG’s drilling industry, we’d love to hear from you!
